comment: Header profiles shared by every host in this spike (WebView2, WebKitGTK, loopback). {ORIGIN} is the app origin, {EXT} the second local server, {IMPORTMAP} the CSP hash of the SRI import map (from sri.json in a served root). 'other' adds the plan 3b headers.
base: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'

other.Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), usb=(), serial=(), hid=(), bluetooth=(), payment=(), display-capture=()

ext.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' {EXT}; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' {EXT}; font-src 'self' {EXT}; connect-src 'self' {EXT}; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; frame-src 'self' {EXT}; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self' {EXT}; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'

sri.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' {IMPORTMAP}; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'
